proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q ha hpq h
  have h0 := h 0
  have h1 := h 1
  have h2 := h (-1)
  have hb : b = -a * (p + q) := by linear_combination (1 / 2) * h1 - (1 / 2) * h2
  have hc : c = a * p * q := by linear_combination h0
  have hD : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = (|a| * (q - p)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, sq_abs, hb, hc]
    ring
  have hne : |a| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.2 ha
  rw [hD, Real.sqrt_sq (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) (sub_nonneg.2 hpq))]
  exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hne).symm
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → p ≤ q → (∀ x : ℝ, a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = a * (x - p) * (x - q)) → q - p = Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / |a|
